column1: # Sr I — NIST ASD, captured 2026-08-14, register 1639.
# destination_url VERIFIED — spectrum=Sr+I confirmed. Levels in cm-1.
# CAPTURE ONLY. Nothing extracted per R 1638.
# ** THE LONGEST SINGLET/TRIPLET-PAIRED SERIES IN THE QUEUE. The
#    5s.nl block on ONE limit carries BOTH multiplicities at every n: **
#      s   n = 6..20   3S and 1S at every n
#      p   n = 5..20   3P* and 1P* at every n
#      d   n = 4..20   3D and 1D at every n
#      f   n = 4..20   3F* and 1F* at every n
#    ** FOUR l VALUES, SEVENTEEN CONSECUTIVE n, SINGLET AND TRIPLET
#       THROUGHOUT. Register 1622 closed Q.exch because singlet and
#       triplet MIX at high n and could only cite the literature for it.
#       Sr I is seventeen consecutive n of the same pairing in four
#       channels — the place that mixing could be watched directly. **
# The 4d.nl block above 45932 sits on the SECOND and THIRD limits and
# turns to jj and Racah notation (2[K], (3/2,5/2)) — refused by R 1576.
# ONLY the 5s.nl block and the low LS states are transcribed. The 4d
# block is ~120 rows of jj/Racah the index cannot key.
